properties.areaDesc: San Bernardino County Mountains; Riverside County Mountains; San Gorgonio Pass Near Banning
properties.headline: High Wind Watch issued October 13 at 11:11AM PDT until October 16 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Northeast to east winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
possible; winds over 70 mph through the San Gorgonio Pass possible.

* WHERE...Riverside County Mountains, San Bernardino County
Mountains, and San Gorgonio Pass near Banning. Highest winds along
the coastal-facing slopes and through the San Gorgonio Pass.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Power outages are possible. Travel could be difficult, especially
for high profile vehicles.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates. Protect
property that may be damaged from high winds.

NWSheadline: HIGH WIND WATCH IN EFFECT FROM THURSDAY MORNING THROUGH FRIDAY EVENING
